impact: A sharp one-day reversal in chips puts Monday's gains in MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS at risk; the rotation into the Dow suggests money is leaving AI hardware rather than the market as a whole. PCE on Wednesday is the next swing factor.
summary: Chips gave back a big part of Monday's surge. Benzinga's close wrap had Nvidia down 7.2% at $153.19, the Nasdaq 100 down 2.7% at 26,034 and the S&P 500 down about 1% at 7,167, while the Dow rose 188 points (0.4%) to 49,783. AMD and Arm fell even harder intraday, and Anthropic slipped below its IPO price. Reports pointed to governance and political doubts over Huang's return, a WSJ report on new tariffs, and caution before Wednesday's October PCE data.
title: Nvidia closes down 7.2%, Nasdaq 100 falls 2.7% as Huang rally reverses
